name: Balrampur Chini Mills Ltd
title: Balrampur Chini Mills Ltd - 500038 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Sugar inventory seen falling to 4.3 Mt (lowest in memory) with domestic prices Rs 41-42/kg supportive, while ethanol price revision remains unannounced for three years and PLA commissioning targeted Q3 FY27.

capex.quote: PLA project post our fundraise, which was going to revise capex at INR3,080 crore

triggers.label: Closing sugar stock 5 Mt → 4.3 Mt
triggers.quote: would reduce the stock from 50 lakh tonnes or 5 million tonnes to 43 lakh tonnes or 4.3 million tonnes

triggers.label: UP sugar Rs 41-42/kg, steady to firm
triggers.quote: In UP, prices have broadly remained in the range of Rs. 41 to Rs. 42 per kg.

triggers.label: Ethanol price revision not done for 3 years
triggers.quote: the absence of revision of ethanol prices under the juice and B-heavy route for the last 3 years

triggers.label: PLA capacity commissioning Q3 FY27
triggers.quote: we look to commission in the third quarter of this year

guidance.quote: we are aspiring to make 35% of EBITDA margin
we look to commission in the third quarter of this year

red_flags.label: Ethanol price unrevised three years; juice/B-heavy margins squeezed
red_flags.quote: the absence of revision of ethanol prices under the juice and B-heavy route for the last 3 years

red_flags.label: PLA customers not yet committed; no offtake disclosed
red_flags.quote: They are not ready to replace their current supplier base with us, as of now.

evasions.topic: PLA offtake agreements and customer volumes
evasions.quote: It is not proper to announce each and every agreement, etc.
At this point, however, if you are saying the current sale of PLA in this environment and the numbers, etc, this is a tough one to answer.
Let things happen. Too many years have gone by. Fingers crossed.
